discussions.name: Salt Lake City
discussions.covers: all of Utah’s ski country, the Wasatch to Brian Head
messages: A Pacific Northwest storm system will bring periods of snow to Utah's mountains through early Saturday, increasingly focused over northern Utah as time goes on. Significant snow accumulations will bring travel difficulties to high elevation routes. Snow levels will drop to northern Utah valley floors Friday night, bringing a chance of accumulating snow.
Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday mornings.
Dry conditions are expected over the weekend, with an active pattern continuing into next week as a weaker system impacts primarily northern and central Utah on Monday.
